title: WaitFor's settle runs to the timeout on a streaming screen, so TestTUI_Esc_InterruptsAContinuedTurn presses Esc after the slow reply ended
observed: Intermittent '39 model requests, want 2' / '23 model requests, want 2'. screen.WaitFor matches, then settle() waits for 60ms of no change bounded only by the WaitFor deadline. The continued reply streams a chunk every 60ms plus an 80ms spinner, so settle held WaitFor for up to 6.4s (100-run measurement, median 1.1s) while the 6.8s reply streamed; when it outlasted the reply, the always-blocking Stop hook continued the turn on instant 'script exhausted' replies until Esc finally landed. With chunk_delay 30ms it fails 5/5 (31-245 requests). Not a kiln interrupt defect: Esc aborted the turn every time.
expected: WaitFor returns shortly after its pattern appears, so a test's next key lands while the state it waited for still holds.
